notes.title: Big Demo Update
notes.notes:
The biggest feature update yet is the addition of scam calls.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931401/7865a39d47254541e33718be7124bf58efb0dd20.gif

Other additions include:
-Take Overs
-Mafia scenarios

Earlier additions (in case you missed them):
- Upgrade your equipment
- Increased interactive options with employees (encourage vs discourage).

Give the demo a try and let me know what you think!

notes.title: July Midway Update
notes.notes:
Despite a hurricane I was able to get a few updates to the demo. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931401/2deb67f3f0ebc2663f6f3e19f4b8f47c3f0d5376.png

- Added "encourage" and "discourage" buttons for the employees (see orange highlights in image)
- Nerfed the actions such that you can only do one action once in a day with that employee. Meaning you can't ask the employee to take a break every turn. Once you select that action for that employee the option goes away.
- Employees will evolve in their skills. Either they will improve (most likely) or they will get worse in a particular skill (blue highlights).

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Thank you so much for the feedback, I've made wholesale changes to the UI and artwork. I've also made a many changes to the code, some of which include:

- revamped the reputation system to account for individual companies' view of you
- the break room is looking a lot more fuller now. If you buy things in the break room for your employees their stress levels decrease at a quicker rate.
- more interactions between employees.


Thanks again for giving this demo a try!
